$schema-note: THE URL allowlist - this is the only whitelist file. Location: ~/.config/little-coder/url-whitelist.json (override with LITTLE_CODER_URL_WHITELIST=/path; there is no cwd or multi-path lookup). Pattern forms: 'example.com' (exact host, any path), '*.example.com' (apex + any subdomain), 'example.com/docs' (host + path prefix), or a full URL (scheme pinned). Covers webfetch, websearch, browser tools, webfetch redirect hops, and any http(s) URL named inside a shell command. Anything not matched asks you (LITTLE_CODER_URL_GATE=ask|block|off).
$add-a-host: append the hostname to the array below, e.g. "reddit.com", "*.reddit.com"; the file is re-read on change, no restart needed
